items.title: Armored Likho Targets Government Agencies, Power Sector with BusySnake Stealer
items.description: A previously undocumented threat actor known as Armored Likho has been attributed to cyber attacks targeting government agencies and the electric power sector across Russia, Brazil, and Kazakhstan.
